title: Choose the visual world for Food Rescue Network
question: Fresh hand. The roll assigned The Banana Leaf. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Banana Leaf
options.lineage: the South Indian banana-leaf meal, where every dish has its fixed place
options.thesis: A rescue is served like a meal on a leaf: every stage has its place, and the leaf is never empty for long.
options.viewport: A wide leaf runs across the page along its midrib; the report form sits where the rice goes, with donor, NGO and volunteer stations served around it.
options.risk: Regional to South India; if the leaf reads as a restaurant brand, the product looks like food delivery.

raised.raise: Every finished step leaves a permanent mark; nothing in a rescue un-happens.
State is a mark, not only a hue: served, folded, set aside each have a shape.
Every rescue reads along one axis, donor to NGO, the line of the midrib.
Content is banded in strict serving rows, one row per stage.
Finished or inactive rescues fold flat to an outline; only live ones are full.

options.label: Kolam
options.lineage: the morning threshold kolam, rice flour on a dot grid
options.thesis: Donors, NGOs and volunteers are dots; each rescue is the one continuous line that joins them.
options.viewport: A dark threshold with a white dot grid; the live rescue draws itself as one looping line under a white headline and a red Report action.
options.risk: Kolam is a well-known Indian motif, so it can read as decoration if the line stops carrying real routes.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: The city as terrain, every rescue a purple course from donor control to NGO finish.
options.viewport: Contour ground with the live rescue as a numbered purple course and a legend of controls.
options.case: Holds product clarity: proximity, routes and punched handoffs are the product; loses identification, orienteering is foreign to the audience.
options.risk: Reads as a sports map if the legend outgrows the task.

options.label: Ebru Floated Pigment
options.thesis: Each drop displaces the last, permanently.
options.viewport: A marbled bath combed into figures.
options.case: Loses both axes: beautiful, but says nothing about rescues.

options.label: Cutting Bench Select Rail
options.thesis: A perforated rail of frames with state as marks.
options.viewport: Frames strung on a rail over grain orange.
options.case: Loses both axes: too close to the rejected rail, and editors are not the audience.
options.kept: State is a mark, not a hue.

options.label: Constructivist Agit-Train
options.thesis: Diagonal red wedges drive the action.
options.viewport: Railcars as broadsides along a diagonal.
options.case: Loses both axes: propaganda register is wrong for a care service.

options.label: Hand-Processed Film
options.viewport: A scratched strip with an orange leak on the live frame.
options.case: Loses both axes: moody and illegible for daily operations.

options.label: Akari Light Sculpture
options.thesis: Lit volumes are live; dark ones fold flat.
options.viewport: Glowing paper volumes at different heights.
options.case: Loses both axes: serene but foreign, and slow for urgent pickups.
options.kept: Inactive items fold flat to an outline.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean nonprofit platform page, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and Report action beside a photo, three feature cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other food-donation platform by design.
